tools.name: find_by_performer
tools.title: Find Venues by Performer
tools.description: Search performer show history across the directory. With All Access, returns every venue where the performer has past or upcoming show listings along with dates and source URLs. Without All Access, returns aggregate show and venue counts across states from the public performer index.

performer.description: Band or solo artist name to search.

include_possible.description: Include fuzzy / possible lineup matches (default false).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get Account & Access Status
tools.description: Return the current user account profile, access level (anonymous, account, or pass), All Access expiration date, remaining free venue reveals, and saved venues count.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.title: Get Venue Details
tools.description: Read a single venue dossier by venue_id (dated show history, stage dimensions, and source links) without spending a free reveal. Note: `search_venues` already returns genres, capacity, music days, and booking contacts and populates the interactive widget, so only call `get_venue` when you need dated show history or stage specs not already in `search_venues`.

tools.name: list_saved_venues
tools.title: List Saved Venues
tools.description: List the signed-in user saved (favorite) venues with level-appropriate venue summaries.

limit.description: Maximum saved venues to return (1-100, default 50).

tools.name: remove_saved_venue
tools.title: Remove Saved Venue
tools.description: Remove a venue from the signed-in user favorites list.

venue_id.description: Venue slug identifier to remove from favorites.

tools.name: reveal_venue
tools.title: Reveal Full Venue Details
tools.description: Unlock and return the full venue dossier (booking contacts, music days, and dated show listings) for 7 days by spending 1 free reveal if the venue is not already revealed. Call this only when the user explicitly asks to reveal or unlock a specific venue.

tools.name: save_venue
tools.title: Save Venue to Favorites
tools.description: Save a venue to the signed-in user favorites list so it syncs across the No Stairs Please website and MCP clients.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.title: Search Live Music Venues
tools.description: Search live music venues across all 50 US states by keyword, state, regional drive-time area, town or multi-stop driving route corridor (stops, or near / to / within_miles), venue type, room capacity, usual music days, or saved favorites. Returns each venue with its genres, capacity, usual music days, and (for All Access or revealed venues) booking contacts and renders the interactive No Stairs Please directory widget.

query.description: Keyword query matching venue name, city, address, venue type, or (with a signed-in account / All Access) genres, performers, and booking contacts. Omit narrow genre keywords when searching a town or route so all matching venues are returned with their genre tags for comparison.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. "WA", "OR", "CO", "CA", "TX") or full state name.

near.description: Origin town ("Bellingham, WA") or "lat, lng" coordinate pair.

to.description: Optional destination town ("Portland, OR") or "lat, lng" to search along a driving route corridor from near to to.

stops.description: Ordered list of 2 to 15 towns or "lat, lng" stops to build a multi-stop driving route (e.g. ["Seattle, WA", "Spokane, WA", "Missoula, MT", "Bozeman, MT"]). Venues are returned in stop-to-stop progression order along the road.

within_miles.description: Maximum distance in miles from near or from the driving route corridor (default 25).

venue_type.description: Venue category such as "Music venue", "Bar & pub", "Brewery & taproom", "Restaurant", "Coffee shop", "Winery & tasting room", "Hall & arts center", "Outdoor stage", "Listening room", "Hotel & resort", "Ski area", "Church", "Community space".

min_capacity.description: Minimum room capacity (e.g. 500 for 500+ cap rooms).

music_days.description: Filter by usual live music days of the week (All Access or revealed venues).

admission.description: Filter by typical admission model: free, paid, or donation (All Access).

min_ticket_price.description: Minimum typical ticket price in dollars (All Access).

max_ticket_price.description: Maximum typical ticket price in dollars (All Access).

favorites_only.description: Filter to venues saved in the signed-in user account.

limit.description: Maximum number of venues to return (1-50, default 25).

resources.name: No Stairs Please Venue Explorer
resources.description: Interactive venue list, detail view, reveal control, and saved venues widget.

resources.name: No Stairs Please Venue Explorer (Skybridge)
resources.description: Interactive venue explorer for OpenAI Apps SDK.
